goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The plot was claimed automatically and cash flowed in. The playtester bought Dropper 4 by touching its pad (step 5 'Upgraded: Dropper 4') and bought Dropper 2 from the shop after a rebirth (steps 17-18). The probe counters (shop_opened 1, shop_purchases 4, tier_upgrades 1, dropper_bought 4) confirm shop use and purchases. The trace never shows the TOP TYCOONS board being looked at (only leaderboard_refresh 79), and the Gold Ore Buy button never fired in any attempt.

bugs.title: Gold Ore shop card 'Buy' button never fires and gives no feedback
bugs.evidence: Steps 1, 3, 6, 8, 11 and 14 pressed ShopUi.Panel.List.Card_tier_gold.State ('Buy' at 739,744) with cash from 2.6K to 5.6K. Every press returned 'button did NOT fire' and only the cash HUD changed. No purchase, price or 'can't afford' message appeared. The price is not visible, so the player can't tell whether the card is unaffordable, locked, clipped, or has no handler. Dropper 2's card did fire (steps 2, 13 and 17).

bugs.title: Tutorial prompt is re-shown constantly
bugs.evidence: Counter tutorial_reshown reached 95 (94 in the probe snapshot, 95 in the last game event at t=393.58) while tutorial_steps stayed at 4. This suggests the tutorial or pad hint is re-triggered repeatedly, which could spam or distract a new player.

bugs.title: Rebirth gives little warning and resets progress
bugs.evidence: Step 15 pressed REBIRTH at $5.8K cash. Cash dropped to 0, the rebirth cost rose from $5000 to $10.0K, and Dropper 2 showed 'Buy' again (step 17). Steps 4, 9 and 16 were denied (rebirth_denied 6) with no obvious feedback in the trace. A new player could lose their pads and cash without a clear confirmation or explanation.
